function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The premise that 'flipper_length_mm' contains numerical values for all penguins is false — there are 2 missing values. Therefore, the population 'all penguins in the dataset' cannot be used for computing the mean flipper length. The analysis must be restricted to penguins with observed flipper length. The population is revised to 'penguins with non-missing flipper length' to match the data. This is acceptable because the missingness is minimal (2 out of 344, ~0.6%), and the values are missing at random (not systematic across species), so excluding them does not introduce bias. The estimand is redefined to 'the species with the highest mean flipper length among penguins with observed flipper length'."}
function.name: resolve_finding
